workouts.warmup: 5 min bike or row, band pull-aparts x20, arm circles, shoulder CARs, push-up x10 slow

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Retract scapulae hard before unracking. Lower to lower chest with control. Drive through the full foot. Own the negative.
30-45° bench. Feel the upper chest stretch at the bottom. Squeeze hard at the top. Don't let the elbows flare beyond 45°.
Initiate with scapular depression. Pull elbows to ribs. Full stretch at top — don't short-change the ROM.
Chest on pad removes lower back. Pure upper back pull. Retract and depress scaps at the top of each rep.
This is a stretch exercise. Own the bottom. Slight elbow bend throughout. Don't let the stretch become reckless.
Rope to face height. Elbows high and wide. External rotate hard at the end. Shoulder health non-negotiable.

workouts.finisher: Cable Chest Press: 3 sets of 20 reps with minimal rest (30s) — pump and blood flow focus
workouts.cooldown: Doorway chest stretch 60s each side, lat hang 45s, child's pose 60s, thoracic extension on foam roller 90s
workouts.progressionNotes: Add 2.5kg to bench when all 4 sets hit 10 reps with clean form. Add 1 rep per session on accessories before increasing weight.

workouts.warmup: 5 min bike, leg swings x10 each, hip circles, goblet squat x10 bodyweight, glute bridge x15

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Brace 360° before descent. Break hips and knees simultaneously. Drive knees out.
Hip hinge — push hips back, not down. Maintain neutral spine. Feel the hamstring stretch load.
Feet low on platform for quad emphasis. Don't lock out at top. Control the negative.
Rear foot on bench. Stay tall. Sink the back knee toward the floor. Drive through front heel.
High-rep pump set. Don't lock out knees. Control the descent.
Slow eccentric is the gold. Lower as far as you can control. Use hands to push back up if needed.

workouts.finisher: Wall Sit: 3 x max hold (aim 45-60s) with 30s rest — quad burnout
workouts.cooldown: Seated hamstring stretch 60s each, pigeon pose 90s each, quad stretch 45s each, hip flexor lunge 60s each
workouts.progressionNotes: Prioritise squat strength. Add 2.5-5kg when all sets hit top of rep range.

workouts.warmup: Band pull-aparts x25, wall slides x10, shoulder CARs x5 each, incline push-up x15

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Lead with upper chest. Full stretch at bottom. Squeeze hard at top.
Seated or standing. Full ROM. Control the eccentric.
Constant cable tension beats barbell for chest isolation. Squeeze pecs at lockout.
Lead with elbows, not wrists. Slight forward lean. Don't shrug. Control the descent.
Lean forward for pec emphasis. Go to full depth.
Lower to forehead or behind head. Elbows stay stationary. Tricep long head emphasis.

workouts.finisher: Diamond Push-Up: AMRAP x2 with 30s rest — tricep and inner pec burnout
workouts.cooldown: Cross-body shoulder stretch 45s each, overhead tricep stretch 45s each, doorway chest stretch 60s each side
workouts.progressionNotes: Rotate primary lift weekly between Barbell Bench and Incline DB Press.

workouts.workoutName: Pull Day — Back & Bicep Width Builder
workouts.warmup: Dead hangs 3x20s, scapular pull-ups x10, band pull-aparts x20, face pull x15 light

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Full dead hang start. Depress and retract scaps before pulling. Chin over bar. Don't kip.
Hinge to 45° and hold. Row to lower abdomen. Elbows drive back, not out.
Wide grip. Pull to upper chest. Let the lat fully stretch at the top.
Rotate into the row for full lat stretch at the bottom.
Hinge 45°+. Arc arms out to side. Rear delts are chronically underdeveloped.
Don't swing. Slow eccentric is the growth driver. Supinate at the top.

workouts.finisher: Chin-Up: max reps x2 sets / Lat Pulldown: 2 x 20 (if pull-ups are limited) — 60s rest
workouts.cooldown: Lat stretch on rack 45s each side, bicep wall stretch 45s each, thoracic foam roll 90s
workouts.progressionNotes: Track total weighted pull-up volume. Progress weighted pull-up before adding more accessory volume.

workouts.warmup: 10 min walk/light bike, hip hinge drills with PVC, glute bridge x20, good morning x10 bodyweight

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Hip hinge is the whole game here. Push hips back. Bar stays close. Feel the full hamstring load.
Bar on pad over hips. Drive to full extension. 2-second squeeze at the top.
Rear foot on bench. Forward lean for glute emphasis. Sink the back knee.
Front load promotes upright torso. Deep full squat.
Greater ROM than barbell. Control the stretch. Squeeze at the top.
Ribs down. Glutes squeezed. No sagging hips.

workouts.finisher: Bodyweight Squat x20 + Push-Up x10: 3 rounds with 45s rest — total body pump
workouts.cooldown: Hip flexor lunge stretch 60s each, chest doorway stretch 45s each, lat stretch 45s each
workouts.progressionNotes: Beginner-focused. Log every session. Increase weight by smallest increment when top rep range is achieved.

workouts.warmup: Arm circles, band pull-aparts x20, light DB curl x15, push-down x15

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Hands shoulder-width or slightly closer. Elbows tuck close to ribs. Biggest tricep builder in the gym.
No swinging. Slow eccentric is non-negotiable. Full ROM. Supinate and squeeze hard at the top.
Lower to forehead or behind. Elbows stationary. Full extension.
Bench at 45°. Arms hang back — maximum stretch on the long head.
Stay upright for tricep emphasis. Full ROM down. Lockout at top.
Neutral grip. Works brachialis and brachioradialis. Control both ways.

workouts.finisher: Curl-to-Press: 3 x 10 — bicep curl straight into overhead press — integrated pump
workouts.cooldown: Overhead tricep stretch 45s each, bicep wall stretch 45s each, wrist flexor/extensor stretch 30s each
workouts.progressionNotes: Arms respond to volume. Track total sets per week (aim for 12-16 sets per muscle).

workouts.warmup: Band pull-aparts x30, wall slides x10, shoulder CARs, push-up x15, light bench x10

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Heavy strength focus. Maximise mechanical tension. Full arch, leg drive, tight upper back.
Upper chest is often underdeveloped. Control the stretch. Elbows slightly tucked.
Lean forward for pec. Full ROM every rep.
Cables from low position, arc up and together. Constant tension — peak contraction focus.
Long head overloaded here. Behind the head maximises stretch. Elbows absolutely stationary.
End of session burnout. Full ROM. Don't compensate with faster reps.

workouts.finisher: Cable Chest Press: 3 x 25 with 30s rest — high-rep pump
workouts.cooldown: Doorway chest stretch 90s each side, overhead tricep stretch 60s each, PVC thoracic extension 90s
workouts.progressionNotes: Advanced: use double progression — increase reps first, then weight.

workouts.warmup: Dead hangs 3x20s, scapular pull-ups x10, band rows x15, light barbell row x10

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Heaviest compound row. Hinge to 45°. Pull to belly button. Upper back contracted hard.
Width comes from pull-ups. Slow eccentric is the stimulus. Full hang at bottom.
Close neutral grip. Chest on pad. Drive elbows back. Rhomboids and mid-traps are the target.
Landmine row variation. Pull in an arc. High elbow at top. Teres major and lats get a unique stretch.
Rear delt health. Elbows high and wide. External rotate hard.
Heavy curl. No swing. 3-second negative. Supinate at top.

workouts.finisher: Chin-Up mechanical dropset: max reps with load → strip weight → max bodyweight reps — 2 rounds
workouts.cooldown: Lat stretch on rack 60s each side, bicep stretch on wall 45s each, thoracic extension foam roll 2 min
workouts.progressionNotes: Advanced back training requires managing cumulative fatigue. Rotate primary row every 4 weeks.

workouts.warmup: Glute bridge x20, clamshell x15 each, hip circle x10 each, resistance band walk x20m each direction

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: The premier glute builder. Bar on pad over hips. Drive to full extension. 2-second squeeze at top.
Hamstring stretch-focused. Push hips back further than you think. Maintain flat back.
Front foot further from bench for more glute. Sink deep. Drive through heel.
Wide stance, toes 45°. Inner thigh and glute emphasis. Go deep. Squeeze glutes hard at the top.
The eccentric hamstring king. Lower as slowly as possible. Catch yourself at the bottom.
Balance challenge + hamstring work. Don't sacrifice depth for balance.

workouts.finisher: Hip Thrust Burnout: 3 x 20 bodyweight, 30s rest
workouts.cooldown: Pigeon pose 90s each, figure-four 60s each, lying hamstring stretch 60s each, hip flexor lunge 60s each
workouts.progressionNotes: Hip thrust progression: target 1-1.5x bodyweight for 10 reps within 12 weeks.

workouts.warmup: Band pull-aparts x25, face pulls x15 light, arm circles, shoulder CARs x5 each direction

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Full ROM is non-negotiable. Seated for stability. Control the eccentric.
Width comes from lateral delts. Lead with elbows. Slow descent builds the muscle.
Rope at face height. Elbows high. External rotate hard. Never skip these.
Hinge 45°+. Lift arms to side. Consistent high volume here changes your physique.
Start with palms facing you, rotate to face out as you press. Hits all three delt heads.
Elbows lead and stay slightly above wrists. Pull to mid-chest.

workouts.finisher: Lateral Raise dropset: heavy x10 → medium x10 → light x10 — 3 rounds, 60s rest
workouts.cooldown: Cross-body shoulder stretch 60s each, neck side stretch 45s each, doorway stretch 60s
workouts.progressionNotes: Lateral raises: prioritise feel over weight.

workouts.workoutName: Compound Strength — Full Body Heavy Day
workouts.warmup: 10 min general movement, hip hinge drills, band pull-aparts x20, empty bar warm-up sets x2

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Strength block. Heavy mechanical tension builds the most muscle. Bracing is critical.
Upper body press anchor. Leg drive. Tight arch. Bar path is an arc.
Heavy row to match heavy press. Back thickness is built here.
Posterior chain accessory. Heavy but controlled.
Overhead strength after the primary movers. Full ROM.
Back width cap to the session. Dead hang. Full ROM.

workouts.finisher: Farmer's Carry: 4 x 30m with heavy dumbbells
workouts.cooldown: Full body stretch sequence — hip flexors, hamstrings, chest, lats, shoulders — 2 min total
workouts.progressionNotes: Heavy compound days require recovery. Sleep 8h minimum. Eat above maintenance.

workouts.warmup: Jumping jacks x30, arm circles, hip hinge bodyweight x10, push-up x10, band pull-apart x15

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: On the floor if no bench. Full ROM limited, but control the negative.
Brace on knee or chair. Elbow to ceiling. Control the descent.
Heavy goblet squat builds serious quad and glute muscle. Go deep.
Dumbbell RDL. Hip hinge is the pattern. Load the hamstrings.
Standing or seated. Full ROM.
Use a chair at an angle if no bench. Arms hang back. Full stretch. Slow eccentric.

workouts.finisher: Dumbbell Complex: Romanian Deadlift x8 + Bent-Over Row x8 + Shoulder Press x8 = 1 round. 3 rounds, 90s rest.
workouts.cooldown: Doorway chest stretch 60s, lat side stretch 45s each, hamstring seated stretch 60s each
workouts.progressionNotes: With limited equipment, progression comes through tempo, rep range, and exercise variation.

workouts.warmup: 5 min bike, dynamic stretching, tempo push-up x5 (very slow), goblet squat x8 slow

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: 5-second descent. 1-second pause. Lighter weight than normal — that's correct.
4-second descent. Full stretch. Time under tension method maximises hypertrophy at lower loads.
3-second controlled return to full stretch. Lat under load for longer.
4-second hip hinge down. Hamstrings loaded slowly and deeply.
Stretch-focused exercise already — add 4-second descent and it becomes elite.
6-second eccentric. The slowest thing you'll do in the gym.

workouts.finisher: Pause Squat: 3 x 10 with 2-second pause at bottom
workouts.cooldown: Full body stretch — extra time on each position given the deep muscle fatigue from tempo work. Minimum 10 min.
workouts.progressionNotes: Tempo training: reduce load 20-30% compared to normal.

workouts.workoutName: Upper Body Volume Day — High Rep Hypertrophy
workouts.warmup: Arm circles, band pull-aparts x20, push-up x15, lat pulldown x15 light, shoulder press x10 light

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Machine isolates the chest beautifully for high-rep work. Control both ways.
High rep pulldown. Full stretch at top. Blood flow to the lats is the goal today.
High-rep laterals build width. Light weight. Perfect form. Lead with elbows.
Constant tension from cables. Squeeze hard at lockout.
Rear delt health and volume. High rep, light weight. Do them every push session.
Neutral grip. Brachialis and forearm pump. No swing.

workouts.finisher: Push-Up x25 + Band Pull-Apart x25: 3 rounds, 45s rest
workouts.cooldown: Doorway chest stretch 60s each side, lat stretch 45s each, neck and shoulder mobility 2 min
workouts.progressionNotes: Volume-focused day. Track total reps per exercise. Add 1-2 reps per set each week before increasing weight.

workouts.warmup: Hip circle x10 each, single leg balance drills, lateral step-up x10 each, single arm press x10 each light

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: The king of unilateral leg training. Sink deep. Address imbalances here.
Single arm requires core anti-rotation. Heavier relative stimulus than bilateral.
Rotate into the row for full lat stretch. Greater range of motion than barbell variations.
Balance challenge + hamstring work. Hold dumbbell in opposite hand.
Single arm lateral raise. Less body English. More honest effort per delt.
Unilateral curl. Neutral grip. No swinging. Arm alternating or simultaneously.

workouts.finisher: Single Arm Overhead Carry: 3 x 20m each arm — shoulder stability and core anti-lateral flexion
workouts.cooldown: Hip flexor lunge 60s each, cross-body stretch 45s each, lat hang 45s, hamstring seated stretch 60s each
workouts.progressionNotes: Unilateral work: correct imbalances before adding load. Weaker side dictates the weight.

workouts.warmup: Jumping jacks x40, push-up x15, pull-up x5, bodyweight squat x20, shoulder circles x10

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Dead hang. Full ROM. Slow eccentric is the growth driver. Stop before form fails.
Tricep long head emphasis. Hands close. Elbows track back. Full ROM.
Full single-leg squat. Control the descent. Arms forward for counterbalance.
Feet elevated shifts load to upper chest and front delts. Straight body. Full ROM.
Plank + row. Minimal hip rotation. Core and back simultaneously.
Core strength to cap the session. Ribs down. Breathe steadily. Don't let hips drop.

workouts.finisher: Push-Up x30 + Pull-Up x10: 2 superset rounds, 90s rest
workouts.cooldown: Doorway chest stretch 60s each side, lat hang 45s, hip flexor lunge 60s each, hamstring 60s each
workouts.progressionNotes: Advanced bodyweight: progression is through weighted vest, tempo manipulation, or harder variations.

workouts.warmup: 5 min walk or bike, cat-cow x10, glute bridge x15, push-up x8, band row x12

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Learn the squat pattern here. Elbows inside knees. Chest tall. This is your foundation.
Safer than barbell for beginners. Control the weight. Feel the chest doing the work.
Machine makes the pattern accessible. Pull elbows to ribs. Full stretch at top.
Hip hinge is a fundamental human movement. Push hips back. Neutral spine.
Seated for stability. Full ROM. Don't overarch the lower back.
Core stability. Ribs down. Glutes on. Build toward 60s over 4-6 weeks.

workouts.finisher: Bodyweight Squat x15 + Push-Up x8: 2 rounds, 60s rest
workouts.cooldown: Hip flexor lunge 60s each, hamstring seated stretch 45s each, chest stretch 45s, child's pose 60s
workouts.progressionNotes: Beginners: increase weight by the smallest increment available when all sets and reps are completed with full control.

workouts.workoutName: Mechanical Advantage Drop Set — Upper Body
workouts.warmup: Band pull-aparts x25, arm circles, shoulder CARs, light cable press x15, lat pulldown x15

mainWorkout.coachingFocus: Mechanical dropset: start in weakest position (incline), progress to stronger positions without rest.
Mechanical lat dropset — same cable, different grips in sequence. Massive lat volume in short time.
After the dropset, standard bench press to build raw strength on a pre-fatigued muscle.
After pulldown dropset, pull-ups finish the lat work. Slow eccentric. Full ROM.
Rear delt always. Every push/pull session. High rep, controlled, consistent.
Rotator cuff and rear delt health. External rotate hard. Elbows high.

workouts.finisher: Push-Up x20 + Chin-Up x8: 3 superset rounds, 60s rest
workouts.cooldown: Doorway stretch 60s each side, lat bar hang 45s, cross-body stretch 45s each, thoracic foam roll 2 min
workouts.progressionNotes: Mechanical dropsets are an advanced technique — use sparingly (once per 2 weeks per muscle group).
